record.body:
## Rationale

The canon library stays unchanged, so there is no shared-code risk and no canon test run. Derived fields and filters are dashboard concerns.

## Counter-argument

Other callers need the same filters. A typed Project.list in canon would remove duplicate filtering code and give every reader the same behavior.

payload.choice: store.py calls Project.list and filters in typed Python functions

record.subject: typed-store-reads
